name: Combination questions proposed by the 2026-09-22 evening review, not yet in the doc
note: Each joins two labels JEV already sees, so the sums can read a state instead of two facts. Every label named here is written on quiet reads too, so the packer never skips the question for a missing label. Evidence is one day (12 graded reads, an outlier-up day); the 'today' notes say what to look for, not what was proven. Suggested home: one new group whose reads list context plus every label below, status shadow until a lane exists to grade them apart from the live set.

vwap_side_volume.ask: Is price above, at, or below the day's average price, and is trading heavy or not for this time of day?

criteria.above_on_heavy: price is more than 0.15 sigma above the day's volume-weighted average price, and volume over the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this time of day
criteria.above_on_thin: price is more than 0.15 sigma above the average, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth for this time of day
criteria.at_on_heavy: price is within 0.15 sigma of the average, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.at_on_thin: price is within 0.15 sigma of the average, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.below_on_heavy: price is more than 0.15 sigma below the average, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.below_on_thin: price is more than 0.15 sigma below the average, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

vwap_side_volume.why: Tests whether a lead over the average holds only while volume stays heavy; confirmed if above_on_thin precedes flat or down and above_on_heavy precedes up or flat. Today: at_on_heavy then down, down; above_on_thin then flat 5 of 5; above_on_heavy then flat 2 of 2.

move_vs_average.ask: Over the last 30 minutes, did price extend away from the day's average, land on it, pull back toward it, or not move?

criteria.extending_above: over the last 30 minutes price rose more than 0.15 sigma, and price is more than 0.15 sigma above the day's volume-weighted average price
criteria.extending_below: price fell more than 0.15 sigma, and price is more than 0.15 sigma below the average
criteria.falling_onto_it: price fell more than 0.15 sigma, and price is within 0.15 sigma of the average
criteria.rising_onto_it: price rose more than 0.15 sigma, and price is within 0.15 sigma of the average
criteria.pulling_back_from_above: price fell more than 0.15 sigma, and price is still more than 0.15 sigma above the average
criteria.bouncing_from_below: price rose more than 0.15 sigma, and price is still more than 0.15 sigma below the average
criteria.no_move: price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was 30 minutes ago
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

move_vs_average.why: Tests whether a fall that lands on the average stops there while one that extends beyond it continues; confirmed if falling_onto_it precedes flat or up and extending_below precedes down. Today: falling_onto_it at 10:56 and 11:00 then down at 30 min, flat at 60; extending_below at 11:17 then flat, then up at 60.

shelf_vs_average.ask: Where is the day's heaviest trading relative to price, and is price above, at, or below the day's average?

criteria.on_shelf_above_average: the heaviest-volume stretch of the day includes the current price, and price is more than 0.15 sigma above the day's volume-weighted average price
criteria.on_shelf_at_or_below_average: the heaviest-volume stretch includes the current price, and price is within 0.15 sigma of the average or more than 0.15 sigma below it
criteria.shelf_above_price_above_average: the heaviest-volume stretch sits above price, and price is more than 0.15 sigma above the average
criteria.shelf_above_price_at_or_below_average: the heaviest-volume stretch sits above price, and price is within 0.15 sigma of the average or more than 0.15 sigma below it
criteria.shelf_below_price_at_or_above_average: the heaviest-volume stretch sits below price, and price is within 0.15 sigma of the average or more than 0.15 sigma above it
criteria.shelf_below_price_below_average: the heaviest-volume stretch sits below price, and price is more than 0.15 sigma below the average
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

shelf_vs_average.why: Joins the two best location scorers today (0.37 and 0.28). Tests whether resting on its own shelf above the average is a flat state and whether dropping off a shelf to the average is followed by a return; confirmed if on_shelf_above_average precedes flat and shelf_above_price_at_or_below_average precedes up. Today: on_shelf_above_average then flat 7 of 7 (12:31 to 15:31).

lean_vs_move.ask: Did the last 30 minutes' volume lean the way price moved, lean against it, or not lean at all?

criteria.leaning_with_a_rise: over the last 30 minutes price rose more than 0.15 sigma, and the volume printed leaning up, beyond the 60% cut
criteria.leaning_with_a_fall: price fell more than 0.15 sigma, and the volume printed leaning down, up-minutes under the 40% cut
criteria.leaning_against_the_move: price rose more than 0.15 sigma and the volume leaned down, or price fell more than 0.15 sigma and the volume leaned up
criteria.move_on_even_volume: price rose or fell more than 0.15 sigma, and the volume printed even within 40% to 60%
criteria.lean_without_a_move: price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was, and the volume leaned up or leaned down
criteria.even_and_still: price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was, and the volume printed even within 40% to 60%
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

lean_vs_move.why: The ungated cousin of volume_backs_move. Tests whether a move carried by one-sided volume continues and a move on even volume reverts; confirmed if leaning_with_* precedes the same direction and move_on_even_volume precedes flat or reversal. Today's three move_on_even_volume reads (falls at 10:56, 11:00, 11:17) then down, down, flat at 30 min, all flat at 60.

lull_volume.ask: How long since price last really moved, and is trading heavy or not for this time of day?

criteria.moving_on_heavy: price last made a real move under 10 minutes ago, and volume over the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this time of day
criteria.moving_on_thin: price last made a real move under 10 minutes ago, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.lull_on_heavy: price last made a real move between 10 and 60 minutes ago, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.lull_on_thin: price last made a real move between 10 and 60 minutes ago, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.stalled_on_heavy: price last made a real move over 60 minutes ago, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.stalled_on_thin: price last made a real move over 60 minutes ago, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

lull_volume.why: activity_state (0.30) and volume_now (0.22) both scored well but reach the sum as separate facts; a stalled tape on heavy volume (absorption) and on thin volume (drying up) are different states. Confirmed if stalled_on_heavy precedes a move more often than stalled_on_thin.

pace_volume.ask: Is the move speeding up or slowing, and is trading heavy or not for this time of day?

criteria.speeding_up_on_heavy: the last 10 minutes moved more than 1.5 times as far as the 10 minutes before, and volume over the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this time of day
criteria.speeding_up_on_thin: the last 10 minutes moved more than 1.5 times as far as the 10 before, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.slowing_on_heavy: the last 10 minutes moved less than two thirds as far as the 10 before, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.slowing_on_thin: the last 10 minutes moved less than two thirds as far as the 10 before, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.steady_on_heavy: the last 10 minutes moved between two thirds and 1.5 times as far as the 10 before, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.steady_on_thin: the last 10 minutes moved between two thirds and 1.5 times as far, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

pace_volume.why: Tests whether acceleration needs volume to carry: confirmed if speeding_up_on_heavy precedes a move and speeding_up_on_thin precedes flat. Today: speeding_up_on_thin then flat 4 of 4.

iv_vs_volume.ask: Is the size of move the options market is pricing rising, falling, or flat, and is the stock's trading heavy or not for this time of day?

criteria.vol_rising_on_heavy: over the last 30 minutes at-the-money implied volatility rose more than 2 vol points, and volume over the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this time of day
criteria.vol_rising_on_thin: implied volatility rose more than 2 vol points, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.vol_falling_on_heavy: implied volatility fell more than 2 vol points, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.vol_falling_on_thin: implied volatility fell more than 2 vol points, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.vol_flat_on_heavy: implied volatility stayed within the 2 vol point flat band, and volume is in the top fifth
criteria.vol_flat_on_thin: implied volatility stayed within the 2 vol point flat band, and volume is in the middle band or the bottom fifth
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

iv_vs_volume.why: Pairs the options market's priced move with volume, so the sum can tell options pricing a move the stock is also trading from options pricing one nobody is trading. Confirmed if vol_rising_on_heavy precedes a move and vol_rising_on_thin precedes flat. iv.trend_30min is omitted in the last hour of expiry day, so expect Friday gaps.

quote_lean_vs_move.ask: Is more size showing on the bid or the offer of the at-the-money option, and did price rise, fall, or go nowhere over the last 30 minutes?

criteria.bid_heavy_after_a_fall: more size on the bid, beyond the 60% cut, and over the last 30 minutes price fell more than 0.15 sigma
criteria.bid_heavy_after_a_rise: more size on the bid, beyond the 60% cut, and price rose more than 0.15 sigma
criteria.bid_heavy_no_move: more size on the bid, beyond the 60% cut, and price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was
criteria.offer_heavy_after_a_fall: more size on the offer, bid under the 40% cut, and price fell more than 0.15 sigma
criteria.offer_heavy_after_a_rise: more size on the offer, bid under the 40% cut, and price rose more than 0.15 sigma
criteria.offer_heavy_no_move: more size on the offer, bid under the 40% cut, and price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was
criteria.even_size: the size showing is about even within 40% to 60%, whatever price did
criteria.unsure: the labels conflict or say too little to call

quote_lean_vs_move.why: Lowest priority: the plain quote_lean question (added 2026-09-23) reads the same label alone; run this combo only if the group has room. Drop first if the group gets crowded.
